Name: Qi Special Board Refresh Config
Author: Darkskyid
Description:
[heading]Description[/heading]
[b]Qi Special Board Refresh Config[/b] lets you control how often the Qi Special Orders board refreshes with new challenges. In vanilla Stardew Valley, the board only updates once per week on Mondays. With this mod, you can set it to refresh daily, every 3 days, or any interval up to 28 days whatever fits your playstyle.
[quote][b]Note:[/b] Changing the refresh interval only affects the [i]next[/i] Qi board refresh. The current board's remaining duration is not affected, so you won't see an immediate refresh just from adjusting the setting. The mod waits for the newly configured number of days to pass before generating new quests.[/quote][line]
[heading]Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] (4.0.0 or later).[/*]
[*]Download and unzip this mod into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for an in-game settings UI.[/*]
[*]Launch the game. The mod will create a
[code]config.json[/code]on first run.[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]Main Features[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Configurable refresh interval -[/b] set the Qi board to refresh every 1–28 days[/*]
[*][b]In-game configuration -[/b] adjust the slider anytime via Generic Mod Config Menu (no restart needed)[/*]
[*][b]Save-safe tracking - [/b]the mod remembers when the board last refreshed per-save, so it works correctly even if you change the interval mid-playthrough[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer compatible - [/b]untested but likely work only host settings apply[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0+[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu [i](optional but recommended)[/i][/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]Shout Outs[/heading]

[*]Thanks to the Stardew Valley modding community for the wealth of documentation and open-source mods that serve as learning material.[/*]
[/list]
